summary: Frontend-only retest completed. The previous critical SVG animation defect is fixed: all 221 polygons begin exact green, expose 34 distinct computed RGB fills during the first sampled staggered transition, settle to exact yellow and red, and return uniformly to exact green. Rapid taps are ignored, performAction logs once per activation, reactivation works, and desktop/mobile clipping passes. Two low-priority development-console warnings remain.

ui_bugs.issue: LOW: Page load emits React's non-boolean DOM attribute console error for `collapsable=false`. react-native-web useAnimatedProps injects collapsable into Animated.createAnimatedComponent(Polygon), and React rejects it for SVG DOM elements. Visual animation still works.
LOW: React Native Web warns that the `pointerEvents` prop is deprecated and should be supplied through style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Move the halo's pointerEvents setting into its style to remove the React Native Web deprecation warning.
Avoid or filter react-native-web's generated collapsable prop on Animated SVG polygons so the browser console remains error-free.
critical_code_review_comments: Previous critical defect is resolved: React Native Animated now updates each SVG polygon's real fill attribute/computed style on web; observed staggered intermediate values and exact settled colors.

The non-boolean collapsable warning originates in node_modules/react-native-web/src/vendor/react-native/Animated/useAnimatedProps.js, which injects collapsable:false into the animated SVG Polygon path.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested behaviors passed; two low-priority console warnings remain

context_for_next_testing_agent: No frontend/.env or REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exists, so the explicitly provided running preview at http://127.0.0.1:3000 was used. Final E2E run observed 221/221 exact green initially, 34 unique RGB values early in transition, 221/221 exact yellow, 221/221 exact red, then 221/221 exact green after reset. Five forced rapid extra taps produced only one first-cycle action log. A second post-reset activation produced the second and only additional log. Desktop was 680x680 and mobile was 346x346; all polygons were children of the group clipped by url(#circleClip).
rca_of_the_issue: The prior Reanimated useAnimatedProps web incompatibility is fixed by Animated.createAnimatedComponent(Polygon) plus progress.interpolate: browser-computed polygon fills now mutate every frame and settle correctly. Remaining warning RCA: react-native-web Animated's useAnimatedProps unconditionally adds collapsable:false, which is not valid as a boolean SVG DOM attribute; TrafficLightButton also supplies the now-deprecated pointerEvents prop directly to Animated.View.
